performance.warmup_policy: one internal warmup request per prompt process excluded; five measured prompts
performance.cold_cost_note: Process wall includes compilation and setup and is reported separately from the warm steady-state request metric.

method_correctness.argument: The retained stack compiles and selects equivalent kernels for the same dense graph, performs the unchanged dense linear-attention aggregation at expressly permitted BF16 precision, rewrites the bias-free FFN 1x1 point projection as the identical per-token linear map, and evaluates the same padded temporal cross-correlation as previous/current/next dense BF16 GEMMs. It omits only W0*x[-1] and W2*x[F], whose operands are exactly zero under the original padding, so their contributions are provably zero.
method_correctness.off_identity: With SGLANG_SANA_FFN_TEMP_LINEAR=0, the original conv_point, reshape/permute, conv_temp, residual, and output reshape path executes unchanged.

gap_report.exit_reason: The final permitted candidate was non-improving and the fixed six-hour site submission window closed.
exhausted_or_rejected: broad TorchInductor compilation and max-autotune selection
BF16 RoPE execution, which did not improve the canonical stack
QKV merge compiler paths, which failed to produce an eligible complete benchmark
FFN inverted 1x1 linear interaction, which regressed the retained stack
gap_report.remaining_assessment: The current measured lossless frontier plateaued well below 2.5x. Exact cross-attention K/V and launch replay had sub-percent measured ceilings; static cuDNN algorithm exploration remained unmeasured when the site window closed, so this is the fastest demonstrated frontier rather than a proof of a global theoretical ceiling.

pareto_assessment: Exactly one lossless exact_fastest point is delivered: 358.39 s total and 323.9216 s denoise, 1.612824x over the frozen baseline. Round 10 was authentic and method-admissible but slower, so it is excluded.
